name: Instagram
description: Publish and read on Instagram through the Instagram API with Instagram Login (graph.instagram.com/v25.0). An Instagram professional account — business or creator — connected once with `degen-portal connect instagram`; no Facebook Page and no Page token involved. Publish images, reels, stories and carousels from public HTTPS URLs, read the account's own media, read conversations, and send direct messages — only to people who messaged the account first, and only to recipients a human allowed on this machine. The access token is minted and refreshed per call and never printed. Instagram has no delete endpoint: a published post cannot be taken back from here.
